name: Maw, Plague
source: Contact Other Plane: World of the Old Scrolls I
book: Contact Other Plane: World of the Old Scrolls I

facets.bk: Contact Other Plane: World of the Old Scrolls I

body:
XP 900
N Medium animal
Init +0;
Senses low-light vision; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 10, flat-footed 16 (+6 natural)
hp 30 (4d8+12)
Fort +7, Ref +4, Will +4
Immune poison and disease

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.

Melee bite +7 (1d8+4+1d4 acid plus disease) or claw +6 (1d4+3 plus disease)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 17, Dex 10, Con 16, Int 1, Wis 12, Cha 2
Base Attack +3; CMB +6; CMD 16
Feats Run, Weapon Focus (bite)
Skills Acrobatics +4, Perception +6, Survival +5

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Disease Zombie Rot

Bite or claw-injury; save Fortitude DC 15 (Con based DC instead of Cha); onset 1d4 days; frequency 1/day; effect 1d2 Con damage (this damage cannot be healed while the creature is infected); cure 2 consecutive saves; Note Anyone who dies while infected rises as a plague zombie in 2d6 hours.

ECOLOGY

Environment deserts or plains
Organization solitary or feasting group (2-5)
Treasure none

This very odd reptile is mostly a mouth and has only two legs. However, this one looks diseased, froth drips from its mouth and it is covered in disgusting sores.

Maws are very hardy creatures and are well known for carrying diseases which affect others that come in contact with them. The worst instance is what is termed the plague maw. It results from a maw feasting on an infected corpse of a plague zombie.
